name: comfyui-base
description: ComfyUI on a GPU pod: install ComfyUI (pinned release) and ComfyUI-Manager, with toolchain, restart and health phases inserted implicitly. Ships no model weights on purpose — add a Models phase pointing at the official repository of whatever you intend to run (see docs/profiles/README.md for the shape). ComfyUI is pinned to a release tag rather than master because master's requirements can pull large workflow-template media; bump the pin deliberately.
